purpose: Design anchor and recommended single-image input for the first owner-operated Tripo generation.
camera: Component-local outer-right three-quarter: camera at +X,-Y with slight elevation toward +Z, looking at the cap center; approximately 45 degrees from Front. +Z is top; +X is screen-right in Front; -Y is outside. Use weak perspective, no roll.
prompt: Using Concept02/16.png as design authority, isolate the wearer's RIGHT shoulder cap: the large rigid deltoid plate on the image-left shoulder of the front figure. Render one complete cap in an outer-right three-quarter product view, top up, broad outside face and shallow curved edge thickness clearly readable. Preserve the source's restrained angular outline, clipped corners, broad faceted face, modest chamfers, dark gunmetal finish, subtle wear and visible recessed rim-fastener arrangement. The crown and bent side portions belong to one continuous shell, not overlapping extra plates. Complete only the occluded continuation as a simple shallow concave interior with modest wall thickness and an open body-facing side; do not make a solid lump or deep bowl. Supporting T-pose images establish placement only, not replacement design details. Center the entire object in a square image with ample white margin, pure opaque white background, neutral soft illumination and no ground or cast shadow. No body, sleeve, straps, torso harness, separate arm armor, extra objects, layered wings, text, labels, dimensions or collage. Do not enlarge into a fantasy pauldron or add decoration.
